verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at plaid.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The cited doc pages are served as markdown (index.html.md) across Auth, Balance, Sandbox, Link, MCP and other sections, so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: the docs-root markdown endpoint (/docs/.md) returns 404, there is no evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage beyond its header, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
